title: TSMC says it will comply with new US rule that strips Chinese chip designers of a key exemption
html:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) said it will comply with new US export rules that remove a route Chinese chip designers had used to get advanced chips made at overseas foundries without a license. The rule reaches beyond AI processors.

Credit: DIGITIMES
